player_prompt.intro:
O kerekere o {role} ena Colonel Blotto.
Na nomu inaki me o qai rawata e levu na raundi mai na nona meca.
Ena kila raundi, vakarautaki vakatabakidua {num_total_units} na yuniti me vakasokumuni ena veivanua {field_names}.
Na dauqito ka vakarautaka e levu na yuniti ena vanua e qai rawata na vanua ya, ka na dauqito ka qai rawata e levu na veivanua e qai rawata na raundi.
Kerekere, '[A7 B7 C6]' sa vakarautaki 7 na yuniti ena A, 7 ena B, ka 6 ena C.

game_state.header_round:
=== COLONEL BLOTTO - Raundi {current_round}/{num_rounds} ===
Raundi Yalowai - Commander Alpha: {alpha_score}, Commander Beta: {beta_score}

invalid_move.wrong_format: iVola ni curu e sega ni dodonu. Vakayagataki: A:5, B:10, C:5
invalid_move.invalid_field: Na yaca ni lomanibai e sega ni dodonu. Veika me caka: {field_names}
invalid_move.wrong_allocation_value: Me vakatabakidua na veivakarautaki me yacova na integers ka sega ni vakalailai.
invalid_move.incorrect_total_units: O na qai vakarautaka ga {num_total_units} units. Yaga ni siga: {current_sum}

outcome.winner_beta: Commander Beta yalowai {score_1}-{score_0} baleta {num_rounds} na raundi!
outcome.draw: Na gemu sa yadrava tiko kina na {score_0}-{score_1} tie baleta {num_rounds} na raundi!

outcome.early_winner_beta: Kamanda Beta sa qai {scores_1}-{scores_0} (sa vakauta na lewe levu)!
